subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Assistir, em vídeo digital, a programa de culinária infantil e, a partir dele, planejar e produzir receitas em áudio ou vídeo.

components.description_pt: Identificar características estruturais e linguísticas do gênero receita assistindo a vídeo infantil de culinária
components.description_en: Identify the structural and language features of a recipe genre by watching a children's cooking video
components.cc_component_description: Explain how structural features of a text contribute to a reader's understanding of its content

components.description_pt: Planejar uma receita em formato de áudio ou vídeo baseando-se em programa culinário infantil
components.description_en: Plan a recipe in audio or video format drawing on a children's cooking program
components.cc_component_description: Create an audio recording of a story or poem for a specific purpose

components.description_pt: Produzir uma receita em formato de áudio ou vídeo usando convenções apropriadas do gênero
components.description_en: Produce a recipe in audio or video format using appropriate genre conventions
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to produce and format a piece of writing for publication

cc_matches.description: Describe the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in a text or part of a text.
Create audio recordings of stories or poems; add drawings or other visual displays to stories or recounts of experiences when appropriate to clarify ideas, thoughts, and feelings.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and link to and cite sources as well as to interact and collaborate with others, including linking to and citing sources.
